headline: Public hearing on the Central Falls Police Department 2026 Application for JAG/Byrne Grant Funds.
summary: The meeting includes a public hearing on the Central Falls Police Department's 2026 JAG/Byrne Grant application. It also includes two mayoral proclamations, one for Domestic Violence Awareness Month and one for Indigenous Peoples Day.
items: Mayor's proclamation of October 2026 as Domestic Violence Awareness Month in the City of Central Falls
Mayor's proclamation of October 12, 2026 as Indigenous Peoples Day in the City of Central Falls
Public hearing on the Central Falls Police Department 2026 Application for JAG/Byrne Grant Funds
location: City of Central Falls, 580 Broad Street, Central Falls, RI 02863

Agenda

Time:

II. Pledge of Allegiance

IV. Executive Communications 
 
a) A proclamation of the Mayor of the City of Central Falls Proclaiming the Month of October

b) A proclamation of the Mayor of the City of Central Falls Proclaiming the Month of October 
12, 2026, as Indigenous Peoples Day in the City of Central Falls. 
 
V. Public Hearing pertaining to the Central Falls Police Department 2026 Application for JAG/Byrne
